Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting consumers by requiring the state to reimburse a retail seller for the state portion of any sales tax paid on interchange fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a sales tax exemption for retailsellers for the state sales tax on interchange fees; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A seller may claim a credit against the tax imposed under RCW82.08.020 on their tax return for the amount of interchange feescharged on retail sales by a financial institution in the same calendaryear as the tax is imposed. (2) The credit in this section only applies to the state portion ofthe tax levied under RCW 82.08.020. (3) The seller must keep records necessary to enable the departmentto verify eligibility under this section. (4) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: (a) "Interchange fee" means the fee a merchant's financialinstitution pays to a cardholder's financial institution when a p. 1 SB 5884cardholder uses a credit card or debit card as payment during a retailtransaction. (b) "Financial institution" has the same meaning as provided in RCW63.14.010(4).
